Delivery that never lands, reaching the batter waist-high and inviting murder
Back-foot slash that sends a short ball flashing past the slips
Stalky middle of the fruit, thrown for the birds to finish
The telly's weather promise, believed against all experience
Public frame that gripped a cheat by the head and hands for jeering
Attendant who carried the shield and hoped one day to earn his own spurs
Two riders thundering at each other on opposite sides of a wooden rail
Tall, narrow stone building climbed by a winding stair
The midday meal, packed in greaseproof and eaten outdoors
Diluted fruit drink of childhood, or to flatten by force
Wristy flick off the pads, the ball scurrying away on the leg side
Deep area beyond midwicket, where the agricultural heave is aimed
